I created a high-severity alert for CMP-POM-01 (30 ml airless pump). The median stockout week is 2026-11-09, with a confidence of 0.82.

- **Why the date is early:** EV-019 confirmed only 12,000 of the 20,000 units on PO-0063. SUP-POM has actually delivered in 60.3 ± 7.1 days against 42 announced, so PO-0064, promised for 2026-10-16, will probably arrive late.
- **Gap with the no-memory view:** A planner who believes the announced lead times would see a stockout in the week of 2026-12-28. That is seven weeks later than the supplier-memory projection.
- **No new alerts elsewhere:** CMP-COF-NOEL, CMP-FLA-50 and CMP-FLA-30 are medium, and their stockout weeks match the alerts already open. CMP-ETU-01 and CMP-ETU-02 show no stockout.

Summary: The partial delivery on PO-0063, combined with SUP-POM's history of late deliveries, moves the pump stockout to the week of 2026-11-09, so I raised a high-severity alert.

alerts.recommendation:
I saved three scenarios, best first. Doing nothing puts €571,097 of revenue at risk, because 8,500 units go unserved.

| # | Scenario | Extra cost | Lost revenue | Total impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rush order from Dosage Riviera (SUP-POM-B) plus gift set first | €680 | €193,521 | **€194,201** |
| 2 | Rush order from Dosage Riviera only | €680 | €252,962 | €253,642 |
| 3 | Prioritise the gift set only | €0 | €436,900 | €436,900 |

**Scenario 1:**
- It orders 8,500 pumps at €0.26 each. The realistic arrival is 2026-11-22, based on a 52-day median lead time.
- The safety margin is 0 days. The pumps land about 13 days after the stockout week of 2026-11-09. A 3,765-unit gap remains, taken from the serums at €51 so the gift set (€89) ships on time.
- Dosage Riviera was late on 4 of its 6 deliveries (±4.4 days), so a slip is possible.

**Scenarios I rejected:**
- **Order from the main supplier, Pompes Atlas (SUP-POM):** The order is 20,000 units at €0.18 each, with a realistic arrival of 2026-11-30. It does not cover the gap, so the impact stays at €571,097. Atlas was late on 14 of 14 deliveries, averaging 60.3 days against 42 announced.
- **Cut the launch by 20%:** The impact is €787,510 and 6,184 units are still missing. This is the worst option.

**Recommendation:** I would do scenario 1. Place the rush order with Dosage Riviera now and allocate pumps to the gift set first. This cuts the impact from €571,097 to €194,201 for €680 of extra cost. Claire has to decide whether to accept serum shortages in the weeks of 2026-11-09 to 11-22 to protect the launch. Confidence is medium-high on the ranking and medium on the exact amounts, because the 0-day margin leaves no room for a delay.
